dish: Seasonal organic plates (smoked trout & tomato with spiced oil; fried chickpeas, yoghurt cream) + natural wines
address: Rue Porte aux Oies 43, 4020 Liège, Belgium
w: Michelin Bib Gourmand (2024) in Outremeuse — chef Tom Foguenne's farm-to-table cooking from local organic producers with a natural-wine list; one of two Liège Bibs announced in 2024.

dish: Seven street-food counters + 40-odd house beers brewed in the basement
w: Liège's former central post office on the Meuse, reopened in Sept 2023 after four years' renovation as Liège's first food market — seven independent counters, a bar pouring beers brewed on site, coworking and the ULiège journalism campus upstairs.

dish: East-African single-origin espresso & filter (Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda) with Rwandan beignets
w: Specialty coffee bar on Rue du Palais serving only East-African coffees with Belgian pastries given an African twist; named among Belgium's ten best specialty cafés in the European Coffee Trip awards.

dish: Flat white on Wide Awake beans with Laiterie des Ardennes organic milk + Gram.laboratoire biscuits
w: Small high-ceilinged coffee bar opened 2022 on Rue des Mineurs, styled like a brutalist antique shop by Volga's co-founder; pours Wide Awake (one of Belgium's best roasters) single origins.
